name: screen_quantile
rationale: screening only — flags the extreme 1 % per dimension; the percentile rank itself is exported

name: min_group_trajectories
rationale: below this a proportion / effect is not interpreted

name: min_athletes
rationale: clusters needed for a cluster-bootstrap interval

name: duration_bins_s
rationale: covers Combine drills (3–10 s) and NFL player-plays (≤ 40 s)

name: speed_bands
rationale: walking / jogging / running / fast / sprint bands

name: rel_error_min_speed
rationale: relative error is unstable near zero speed

name: resid_range
rationale: M1 p95 |Δ| ≤ 0.37 yd/s in every group → ±1 covers the bulk; tails beyond are counted in edge bins
